slug.label: Workspace address
slug.hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. This is the address people use.
slug.invalid: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.

general.title: Organization
general.description: The name and address of this workspace.
general.name: Organization name
general.slugWarning: Changing the address breaks existing links to this workspace.
general.dangerDescription: These change who controls the workspace, or remove it entirely.
general.transferBody: The new owner gets full control. You become an admin.
general.noOtherMembers: There’s nobody else to transfer ownership to yet.
general.transferConfirmBody: {name} gets full control of this workspace, including deleting it. You become an admin and can’t undo this yourself.
general.deleteBody: Everyone loses access and the workspace stops appearing anywhere.
general.deleteConfirmBody: Everyone loses access to the projects, documents, files and requests in this workspace.
general.typeNameError: Type the organization name exactly to confirm.

members.title: Members
members.description: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in this workspace.
members.caption: Workspace members
members.titleHint: Shown next to their name in people pickers.
members.suspendedToast: {name} can no longer sign in to this workspace
members.removeConfirmBody: Their open tasks become unassigned and they lose access immediately. Comments and history stay.

invitations.inviteDescription: Invitations are sent by email and expire after 7 days. They grant nothing until accepted.
invitations.emailsHint: One or more, separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
invitations.sendInvites: {count, plural, =0 {Send invitations} one {Send 1 invitation} other {Send # invitations}}
invitations.sent: {count, plural, one {Invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}
invitations.pendingDescription: People who have been invited but haven’t accepted yet.
invitations.revokeConfirmBody: Their link stops working straight away. You can invite them again later.
invitations.noPendingHint: Invitations you send appear here until they’re accepted.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Teams group people, and team-visible projects are open to everyone in them.
teams.name: Team name
teams.deleteBody: People stay in the workspace; only the grouping goes. Team-visible projects fall back to their members.
teams.emptyBody: Create a team to group people and open projects to all of them at once.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Shared labels for tasks across every project.
labels.name: Label name
labels.usedOn: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used on # task} other {Used on # tasks}}
labels.deleteBody: {count, plural, =0 {This label isn’t used on any task.} one {It will be removed from # task.} other {It will be removed from # tasks.}}
labels.emptyBody: Labels help you group work across projects.

forms.title: Request forms
forms.description: The forms people fill in to submit a request. Each form’s fields become the request’s answers.
forms.emptyBody: Create a form so clients and the team can submit requests.
forms.detailsDescription: What this form is for and who can use it.
forms.name: Form name
forms.audienceHint: Client contacts only see client forms.
forms.defaultOwnerHint: Who triages requests from this form.
forms.activeHint: The form appears when someone starts a request.
forms.inactiveHint: Hidden from new requests. Existing requests keep their answers.
forms.fieldsDescription: Up to 15 fields. Title and details are always asked for; these are extra.
forms.noFields: No extra fields yet. The form still asks for a title and details.
forms.fieldKeyHint: Used in exports; change it rarely.
forms.titleNote: Requests always ask for a title and details as well.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who changed what in this workspace. Entries can’t be edited or deleted.
audit.emptyBody: Changes to the workspace appear here as they happen.
audit.filteredEmptyBody: Try another area or clear the filter.

export.title: Data export
export.description: A machine-readable copy of this workspace’s data.
export.requested: Export requested. It will be ready shortly.
export.note: The export is a gzipped JSON file with projects, tasks, documents, requests, approvals, comments and member records. File contents are listed by metadata, not included. Download links work for 7 days.
export.inProgress: An export is being prepared. Refresh this page in a moment.
export.emptyBody: Request one and it will appear here when it’s ready.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted projects can be restored here. Deleted tasks, documents and files are restored from their own project.
trash.emptyBody: Projects you delete appear here until they’re purged.
